basic_details.job_title: NIMS Scientific Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) has announced 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Scientific Coordinator under advertisement number SRC/AC-3/R&P/606/2022, with a tenure of 1 year. Candidates applying for this temporary position must submit their offline applications to the Dean's office, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences Panjagutta, Hyderabad on or before 27 October 2026. Applicants should download the application form, fill it in, and attach attested copies of certificates in support of all information furnished. The required qualification for the Scientific Coordinator post

faq.question: Q1. Is the Scientific Coordinator position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary for a tenure of 1 year, and there is no right for claiming any regular appointment in NIMS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Scientific Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 50 years.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be communicated regarding the interview date over phone or e-mail.

faq.question: Q4. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Dean's office, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad - 500082.
